question: What is the meaning of energy performance in relation to building physics?
description: Energy performance in relation to building physics refers to the efficiency with which a building uses energy for heating, cooling, lighting, and other purposes. It is influenced by factors such as insulation, window design, and building orientation. A building with good energy performance will require less energy to maintain a comfortable indoor climate, resulting in lower energy bills and reduced greenhouse gas emissions. This is crucial for sustainable construction, as it aligns with the principles of reducing energy consumption and promoting environmental sustainability.
